name: Viagem Medieval em Terra de Santa Maria
description: Don't miss the final days of Europe's largest medieval reenactment. A short trip from Porto transports you to a world of jousting knights, bustling markets, and grand parades.
longDescription:
Viagem Medieval em Terra de Santa Maria is an annual historical reenactment event held in Santa Maria da Feira, near Porto. It is recognized as one of Europe's largest medieval festivals, transforming the town into a recreation of a medieval settlement. The event is organized by the Municipality of Santa Maria da Feira and a local business association, aiming to celebrate and educate visitors about medieval history and culture.

Visitors to Viagem Medieval can expect to encounter a wide array of historical activities and performances. The event features reenactments of medieval battles, jousting tournaments, and demonstrations of traditional crafts. The streets are populated by costumed performers, and a large market offers period-appropriate goods and food. The atmosphere is immersive, designed to transport attendees back to the Middle Ages within the historic setting of Santa Maria da Feira.

This ticketed event runs from August 6th to August 9th, 2026, marking its final days. Santa Maria da Feira is accessible from Porto by car or regional bus services, with the journey typically taking around 30-45 minutes. Specific details regarding ticket purchase locations and prices are usually available closer to the event date through official channels.
